Preserve every positive English and Korean clause, material, count, part, owner, attachment, endpoint, state and scope. Use only when compatible with independently frozen requester meaning and every affected dimension and property. Every distinguishing component and directed relation must be legible together in the selected evidence unit; hidden, cropped, partial or unobservable required evidence does not pass. Research graphs, aliases and citations add no typed native facts, guard evidence, owner permissions or whole-source qualification. Visible form does not establish consent, rights, life state, diagnosis, continuity of identity, consciousness, historical sequence or causation. Declared sequences and still-image proxies retain their distinct evidence scopes.
